title: Gold Robot EA [EMA and Price Pattern]
entry_long: EMA9>EMA200 and EMA9 crosses above EMA26 (bar ID1) + bullish engulfing, body ID1>ID2
entry_short: mirror: EMA9<EMA200, EMA9 crosses below EMA26 + bearish engulfing
exit: trailing stop 500/step100 (ask for buy, bid for sell), no SL, no TP
buildon_idea: already capped at 2 lots; flat-lot test first; try linear/log lot law
novelty_note: simple EMA-align + engulfing; common — low novelty

title: Semi Auto EA [Grid Trading System]
entry_long: if price drops, adds grid orders 150 pips apart at pre-defined levels
entry_short: if price rises, adds grid orders 150 pips apart at pre-defined levels
exit: take profit at +100 pips total; cut loss at -3000 money
escalation_cap: positions 1-4 at 0.01; position 5+ escalates (amount unspecified); kill at -3000
buildon_idea: add explicit position cap (e.g. max 8 orders); flat-lot 0.01 test to verify grid entry; try linear-add or log-scale instead of step escalation
novelty_note: grid recovery with step escalation; common retail pattern, low-moderate novelty

title: Custom Sequence
entry_long: candle low pierces below support but closes above (bullish engulfing/bounce)
entry_short: candle high pierces above resistance but closes below (bearish engulfing/bounce)
exit: SL 30 pips; TP 50 pips; on loss escalate lot in sequence; on profit reset to base 0.01
escalation_cap: user-defined: loss1 0.02, loss2 0.03, loss3 0.05; profit resets 0.01
buildon_idea: sequence is bounded; flat-lot 0.01 test to validate S/R bounce edge; extend sequence depth; test multi TF/symbol
novelty_note: S/R reversal + user-defined escalation; moderate novelty, reusable entry

title: Semi Auto EA [Best Martingale Strategy and Trailing Stop]
entry_long: manual first trade; recovery: price drops >=20 pips AND EMA3 crosses above EMA8
entry_short: manual first trade; recovery: price rises >=20 pips AND EMA3 crosses below EMA8
exit: trailing stop (no fixed TP/SL), triggers on unrealized profit >= 60*position_count; kill at -3000
escalation_cap: doubles each recovery (0.01,0.02,0.04...); no position limit
buildon_idea: add position count cap (e.g. max 6); flat-lot test to isolate EMA entry edge; validate EMA cross multi symbol/TF; consider per-trade SL
novelty_note: EMA crossover + martingale + trailing exit; moderate novelty
